title: Gemini Search now points at the right Flash model
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: smoother Gemini Search, more community chat projects, and clearer signals from Pollen and Nano Banana.

The gemini-search route now uses the Vertex-specific gemini-2.5-flash-vertex model ID, keeping search requests on the intended model rather than relying on a name that sounds close enough for software.

Strapick Chat and LLMS were added to the project listings, giving people two more community-built chat experiments to discover and poke at.

Pollen MVP moved to v0.2, while Nano Banana gained fuller logging and user-stat tracking. Telemetry now also records requested and actually used models correctly, making the system's account of itself a little less fictional.
